name: PDF Documents
lede: PDF work is mostly page-tree surgery: which pages exist, in what order, and how each page is drawn. These tools read the file into memory, rewrite the object graph, and hand the result back as a download.
description: Assemble, split, rotate, watermark and inspect PDFs. The page tree is rewritten with PDF-lib inside the tab, so nothing is uploaded and no queue exists.

name: Images & Metadata
lede: Raster work in the browser is Canvas work: decode to a bitmap, draw into a target surface, re-encode. That makes quality and dimension trade-offs explicit instead of hiding them behind a black box.
description: Resize, crop, convert, compress and strip metadata from JPG, PNG and WebP using Canvas and an in-tab EXIF parser.

name: Color & Palettes
lede: Color tools are measurement tools. They report what the pixels actually contain — in sRGB, hex and HSL — rather than guessing a mood.
description: Read exact pixel values, extract a usable palette and export swatches for design handoff.
